articles.title: What are Mariners looking for in new manager? Here’s what Jerry Dipoto said.

articles.title: Mariners place Andrés Muñoz on injured list, ending his season

articles.title: Mariners fans send heartfelt thanks to Rick Rizzs: ‘You’re the reason I love baseball’
